name: Optery Free Basic
free_limit: Free personal-data exposure scan at signup and recurring Exposure Reports approximately every 3 months when the account was accessed within the previous 3 months; self-service data broker opt-out tools and profile visibility links.
watch_out: No automated data-broker removal on Free Basic; removal requests must be submitted manually. Fresh on-demand Custom Scans cost extra. Availability is country-dependent; the pricing page lists US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand and South Africa. Business/commercial eligibility requires confirmation.
